# Companion build dependencies

- MinHook **1.3.4**, commit `c3fcafdc10146beb5919319d0683e44e3c30d537`:
  https://github.com/TsudaKageyu/minhook/tree/v1.3.4 . BSD license retained in
  `minhook/LICENSE.txt` and the source headers.
- NVIDIA Streamline **2.14.1** public include headers:
  https://github.com/NVIDIA-RTX/Streamline/tree/v2.14.1/include . NVIDIA's permission
  notice is retained in each header. No NVIDIA runtime DLL is included here.

These files were copied from the previously verified AC8 dependency checkout/SDK.
The companion is a separate project from upstream SM86's unpublished kernel backend.
